overall: The committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to respond within 10 days to requests for executive session minutes; the violation was intentional, so the matter was referred for hearing with a recommended $500 fine.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee failed to timely respond to June 26 requests for executive session minutes on superintendent selection and negotiations and non-union personnel.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to respond to a request for executive session minutes within 10 days.

remedy: Civil penalty of $500 recommended, with the matter referred for a hearing under 940 CMR 29.07(3) (intentional violation).
Order of immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We recommend the imposition of a civil penalty of $500 and an order of immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
